Players Committee card image of [[Hunting Party (V)]] (original printing), game text: “During your control phase, if your bounty hunter or Trandoshan is escorting a non-frozen captive at a battleground site you control, opponent loses 1 Force. OR If your bounty hunter or Trandoshan just captured a character, opponent loses 1 Force. (Immune to Sense.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/huntingparty.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018).
